caseName: Great Western Mining & Manufacturing Co. v. Harris
caseNameFull: Great Western Mining and Manufacturing Company, etc. v. Charles A. Harris, Executors, etc.

opinions.text: April 11, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted. Mr. Harlan Cleveland for petitioner. Mr. Julien T. Davies and Mr. Brainard Tolles for respondents.
